name: restos-desktop
description: RestOS v4 Desktop — POS система для ресторанов (Go-бэк + embedded Postgres, LAN web access)

scripts.build-frontend: cd .. && npx vite build && rm -rf desktop/frontend && cp -r dist desktop/frontend
scripts.embed-spa: cd .. && rm -rf server/internal/transport/http/spa && mkdir -p server/internal/transport/http/spa && cp -r dist/. server/internal/transport/http/spa/
scripts.build-sidecar-win: npm run embed-spa && cd ../server && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o bin/restos-server-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/restos-server && cp bin/restos-server-windows-amd64.exe ../desktop/resources/restos-server.exe
scripts.build-sidecar-mac: npm run embed-spa && cd ../server && go build -trimpath -o bin/restos-server ./cmd/restos-server && cp bin/restos-server ../desktop/resources/restos-server
scripts.dist:win: npm run build-frontend && npm run build-sidecar-win && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build-frontend && npm run build-sidecar-mac && electron-builder --mac
